question: Ms Bhakti Pradip Kulkarni was conferred with the Arjuna Award 2022 for her outstanding contribution in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhakti Pradip Kulkarni:-**

 
 
• She​ is an** Indian chess player** who has won** several national and international tournaments.**
 
• She was awarded the** Arjuna Award in 2022,** which is one of the highest honors for sports in India.
 
• The award is given to athletes who have **consistently performed well **at the international level and brought laurels to the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis:**

 
 
• India has produced several world-class table tennis players, including **Sharath Kamal and Manika Batra.**
 
• However,** none** of them were conferred with the Arjuna Award in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Badminton:**
 
 
• India has a strong tradition in badminton, with players like **Saina Nehwal and PV Sindhu **winning Olympic medals.
 
• However, they were **not **the recipients of the Arjuna Award in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in wrestling, with several wrestlers like **Sushil Kumar **winning Olympic medals.
